[issue by ZaRe4per]
### Steps to Reproduce the Crash

Opening my inventory instantly causes my game to instantly crash.

### Mod Pack URL (Optional)

_No response_

_No response_

### Extra Notes (Optional)

Minecraft Version 1.21.1 
Neoforge 21.1.265
JEI 19.70.0.460
Latest Log: https://gist.github.com/ZaRe4per/83b7f428c7df0cf9c1e47b7f0ebbeaa0

This crash even happens when opening my inventory for the first time after creating a new world. I have also confirmed that opening other inventories such as chests also instantly crashes the game.
